name: Mallet Finger
definition: Loss of active distal interphalangeal extension due to terminal extensor tendon injury, with or without avulsion fracture.

investigations.principle: Radiographs assess avulsion fracture and joint alignment.

green: Continuous DIP extension splinting for suitable injuries
amber: Large articular fracture, volar subluxation or failed splinting may need surgical review.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Anguli/Snayu injury phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Loss of active distal interphalangeal extension due to terminal extensor tendon injury, with or without avulsion fracture.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise, locked joint or other listed red flags.
